title: Mini Conscious Dance Class 1: The body parts  | Conscious Ecstatic Dance Short Class

method.teacher_system: The teacher leads a guided breathing and grounding session, explains the purpose and source of the conscious dance practice, and then invites free movement through different body parts while encouraging self-acceptance and respectful boundaries.
method.signature: Sharing personal vulnerability about the fear of being seen and inviting students to work through it together.

practices.what: Takes deep breaths to get centered and grounded.
Closes eyes and relaxes the belly, tuning attention into the spine.
Shifts attention progressively from the spine to the shoulders.
Moves attention down the spine into the pelvis and hips.
Brings focus into the thigh bones and knees.
Directs awareness down into the ankles and feet.
Brings awareness back up to the neck and head for hair-dancing.

adaptations.difficulty: Pushing too hard or feeling restricted
adaptations.adjustment: Respect your limits and where you are at today with no need to push or hold back

beliefs.belief: Every time you return to a simple foundational practice, your body, heart, mind, and spirit show up differently.

feelings.response: Shares her own fear of being seen and notes that taking gentle steps helps work through it.

moments.says: The teacher invites the learner to take a few deep breaths to get centered and grounded.
The teacher encourages the learner to be with what is showing up right now and accept that every day is different.
The teacher reminds the learner to respect their limits and where they are at today with no need to push.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling accepted, grounded, and attuned to their own body's natural pace.

struggles.theme: Overcoming fear of being seen and isolation
Battling self-confidence and shyness in dance

clicked.theme: Found it gentle, meditative, and a great re-entry to dance

requests.theme: Asking for track names or artist details for the music

meant.theme: Brought tears of joy, stress relief, and feeling glowing with life

method.limits: The video is performed in a solo home studio setting, so partner or group dynamics cannot be demonstrated.
